title: The Jamestown Ledger
description: Early seventeenth-century English settlers in Virginia face starvation, harsh winters, disease, and tense negotiations with the Powhatan confederacy.

title: The Spanish Galleon
description: A Spanish naval navigator on a seventeenth-century treasure galleon crossing the Atlantic faces privateers, mutinous crewmen, and hurricane seas off the Caribbean.

title: The Suffragette's Banner
description: In Edwardian London of 1912, brave women organize protest marches, endure imprisonment, and demand voting rights against harsh parliamentary opposition.

title: The Cotton Mill Rebel
description: During Manchester's Industrial Revolution in the 1840s, a teenage loom operator organizes factory strikes for fair wages and child labor protections.

title: The Codebreaker of Bletchley Park
description: Brilliant women mathematicians and linguists work in secrecy in World War II Britain to decipher German Enigma naval ciphers and alter the course of the war.

title: The Roman Legionary
description: Stationed at Hadrian's Wall on the northern frontier of Roman Britannia, a centurion faces brutal winters, local Pict rebellions, and imperial legion politics.

title: A Tale of Two Dynasties
description: In sixteenth-century Ming Dynasty China, a scholar-official balances Confucian court etiquette against imperial corruption and nomadic border skirmishes.

title: The Golden Age of Cordoba
description: In tenth-century Moorish Andalusia, Jewish, Christian, and Muslim scholars collaborate in the great library of Cordoba translating classical Greek philosophy.

title: The Oregon Trail Diaries
description: Pioneer families in covered wagons brave cholera, river crossings, mountain blizzards, and harsh terrain on the dangerous 2,000-mile trek to the Pacific coast in 1848.

title: The Warsaw Ghetto Violin
description: In Nazi-occupied Warsaw, a Jewish classical violinist plays concerts in secret attics to sustain hope among community members organizing the historic ghetto uprising.

title: The Viking Skald
description: In ninth-century Scandinavia, a Norse poet journeys aboard longships across stormy seas to Anglo-Saxon England, singing sagas of kings, raids, and conquest.

title: The Medici Bank
description: In fifteenth-century Florence, patrons of Renaissance art and financial magnates in the House of Medici navigate papal papal intrigue and rival Florentine merchant families.

title: The Dust Bowl Exodus
description: During the Great Depression of the 1930s, an Oklahoma farming family flees suffocating dust storms and bank foreclosures on the migrant route to California.

title: The Czar's Apothecary
description: An English herbal doctor at the sixteenth-century Moscow court of Ivan the Terrible concocts medicines while walking a razor's edge amidst royal paranoia.

title: The Alamo Courier
description: In 1836, a young Tejano rider slips past General Santa Anna's siege lines in San Antonio to deliver William Travis's desperate pleas for reinforcements at the Alamo.
